name: Romania

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 19043151 inhabitants, recorded as 19.043 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Collected on 2026-07-27, in Romanian, in the transversal venues pass. Sixteen units, fifteen houses and one stage, each named with its address and the public authority that founded it. The opening estimate was 15 in a range of 12 to 18, and the sourced figure lands inside it, which is luck: the estimate had no list and could not have said which theatres it meant. Two documents were paired, and neither would have done alone. The first is the Ministry of Culture's Registrul Artelor Spectacolului, section 'Instituții de spectacole sau concerte', downloaded and read in full: it holds the public performing-arts institutions of the country with their official name, fiscal code, street address, town, county, director, website and — decisively for this denominator — the public authority that founded each one. Fourteen of the fifteen houses below are county councils or municipal councils named in that register, and Țăndărică answers to the General Council of the capital. What the register does not carry is any column for the kind of theatre, and Romanian puppet houses are almost all named for a character rather than for puppetry — Țăndărică, Gulliver, Puck, Colibri, Prichindel, Arlechino, Vasilache, Merlin, Luceafărul, Gong, Ariel, Căluțul de Mare — so a search of the register for the words păpuși, marionete or animație returns one entry out of one hundred and thirty-two. The second document supplies the genre: the directory of Romanian puppet, marionette and animation theatres published by Țăndărică itself, fifty-eight pages, one monograph per house. A theatre is counted here when it appears in both — public institution in the register, puppet or animation theatre in the directory. The pairing corrected one case and created another. Teatrul Municipal 'Ariel' in Râmnicu Vâlcea is in the register and looks like a puppet theatre by name; the directory shows it is not the puppet house of that town. The puppet section of Râmnicu Vâlcea was founded in 2001 inside Teatrul 'Anton Pann', subsidised by the local council, and it is recorded here as the one stage in the count. Disputed, and 16 is a floor. The Anton Pann case is the reason: a puppet section inside a drama institution is invisible to both documents unless the directory happens to describe it, and the directory names puppet theatres at Baia Mare, Ploiești, Pitești and Bacău, and a Hungarian-language puppet company at Oradea, none of which could be matched to a register entry today — at Bacău the animation theatre Licurici appears to have been absorbed into the Teatrul Municipal Bacovia, which is in the register with no genre attached. Each is a plausible unit and none is counted, because a name in a historical monograph is not a live institution. The other open question is the older one, unchanged: Romania's statistical office publishes a count of teatre de păpuși și marionete which would give a national total to check this list against, and insse.ro reset the connection at the transport layer on every route on 2026-07-27, as it did on the earlier attempt. Coordinates are geocoded from the addresses through Nominatim; several resolved to the theatre building under its own name.

observations.reasoning: Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. One establishment retained: UNATC I.L. Caragiale, Bucharest. Criteria read at source: a bachelor's degree in Performing Arts (Puppets and Marionettes), four years, 240 ECTS, twelve places, paired with a master's in Animation Theatre; puppetry named in the award title; Romanian public national university. Counted by establishment: bachelor's and master's make one school. The previous value of 1.5 was not an observation but the midpoint of an estimated range; it is brought back to the established lower bound. Upper bound at 2: the arts university of Targu Mures was not checked in this pass. No source read claims exhaustiveness for Romania.

venues: retry insse.ro for the count of teatre de păpuși și marionete. It is the only national total that would say whether the sixteen enumerated on 2026-07-27 are all of them. Every route reset the connection on two separate attempts.

venues: look for puppet sections inside Romanian drama institutions. Râmnicu Vâlcea's, founded 2001 inside Teatrul Anton Pann, was found only because the Țăndărică directory describes it, and there is no reason to think it is the only one.
